title: HackToday 2023 Quals
summary: RSA with leaked d^e and φ^e plus Gaussian-integer factoring, an AES CBC/CFB oracle, a byte-by-byte unknown cipher and RSA with a tiny prime.

title: COMPFEST 15 Quals
summary: Recovering an RSA modulus with gcd then CRT, image encryption in a multiplicative group, a Merkle–Hellman knapsack broken with LLL and an ECDSA verifier bypass.

title: TCP1P CTF 2023
summary: RSA leaks via gcd, meet-in-the-middle on double AES, Mersenne Twister prediction, LFSR mask recovery, a CBC padding oracle and small-e RSA behind an ECC captcha.

title: National Cyber Week 2023 Quals
summary: Recovering an AES-CFB8 key, a man-in-the-middle on Diffie–Hellman and a low-exponent attack on a double RSA scheme.
